sections.Profile:
"Party Zone," released by Bally in September 1991, is a lively and vibrant pinball machine designed by Dennis Nordman. The game features characters from previous Bally machines, including "Party Animal," "Elvira and the Party Monsters," and "Dr. Dude and His Excellent Ray," all converging at the Cosmic Cottage for a party. The machine incorporates unique elements like an animated Captain B. Zarr head that follows the ball, a Dancing Dummy, and a Supersonic Robotic Comic.
